notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.7)
notes.content: * Fixed an issue where players could be kicked for inactivity during extended Bonus Time sessions in online multiplayer.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.6)
notes.content: * Fixed an issue that prevented button selection when downgrading and hiding buttons when playing with a gamepad.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.5)
notes.content: * Fixed a problem where the background music would not return to normal after the bonus time ended.

notes.title: Update (Ver 1.0.4)
notes.content:
Additions & Adjustments:

* Added Ramen Avatar to Upgrades.

* Added an automatic ball firing feature (Auto-shoot).

* Increased the rate at which the Monster Difficulty rises upon successful monster subjugation.

* Raised the maximum level for the Faster Movement upgrade.

* Slightly lowered the difficulty of the "Catch the balls!" event.


Bug Fixes:

* Fixed an issue where memory usage gradually increased each time the player returned to the Title Screen from the game.

* Fixed an issue where BGM would not play correctly if a new Bonus Time started consecutively during an ongoing Bonus Time and an active event.


# Please note that we will not be able to match players with different versions of the game.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.3)
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where firing a gem bomb while using the vacuum skill would cause it to go off.

- Fixed an issue that caused the load to increase slightly each time a barrels down event occurred.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.2)
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where Gem bombs could not be used even though they were released under certain conditions.

notes.title: Fixed (Ver 1.0.1)
notes.content:
- Addressed an issue where performance would degrade after playing for an extended period.

- Fixed an issue during multiplayer where a reward drop notification (e.g., "3rd Place Reward Drop", "4th Place Reward Drop") was incorrectly displayed for players finishing in 3rd place or lower, even when no reward was actually assigned for those ranks.
